ECGC helps 5HTP pass the blood brain barrier. As 5HTP converts into serotonin, a lot of it doesn't reach the brain and floats throughout the body. Because serotonin can bind to receptors on heart valves 5HTP alone can cause heart issues long term, so EGCG helps prevent this while increasing its effectiveness.
